mapper.sql: b.id, b.archive_version_id AS version_id, b.task_id, b.status, b.engine_version, b.processing_duration_ms, b.review_required, b.error_code, b.created_at, b.document_type, b.preview_url, b.preview_content_type, b.preview_size, b.preview_sha256, b.preview_width, b.preview_height, b.error_message, b.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocr_binding b WHERE b.archive_version_id = #{versionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id WHERE b.archive_version_id = #{versionId}
LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id WHERE b.id = #{id}
LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocr_binding ( archive_version_id, task_id, document_type, status, engine_version, processing_duration_ms, review_required, error_code, error_message, preview_url, preview_content_type, preview_size, preview_sha256, preview_width, preview_height, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{versionId}, #{taskId}, #{documentType}, #{status}, #{engineVersion}, #{processingDurationMs}, #{reviewRequired}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{previewUrl}, #{previewContentType}, #{previewSize}, #{previewSha256}, #{previewWidth}, #{previewHeight}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO ocr_field_revision (binding_id, field_code, previous_value, current_value, reason, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{fieldCode}, #{previousValue}, #{currentValue}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, binding_id, field_code, previous_value, current_value, reason, operator_id, created_at FROM ocr_field_revision WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
